notes.title: Patch Notes #2
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35238896/71b8325b5a3f8efae8f0c214c40ad293a3d7d41e.png

Fellow Alchemists,

we’re still working on improving our game and now we have great news for you! ːsteamhappyː Another boost is coming to our game, a bunch of things added or fixed to Make Brewing Potions Easier Again…! Or something like that. ːsteamfacepalmː

Here is the list of the fixed bugs and new features:

 processed ingredients don't vanish from the shelf (new feature),
 canceling active quest (new feature),
 additional pop-up text while selling/returning potion,
 added inverted mouse option in the settings,
 added VSync toggle option in the settings,
 FOV camera fixed on Almanach,
 improved delivery box mechanic,
 some translation improvements.

We're always open to your suggestions, so feel free to contact us if have some idea about what you want to see in Alchemist Simulator! ːsteammockingː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1105040/Alchemist_Simulator/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35238896/b0b4bb0b3a9fe4b9980c90131e29ae6a84b92baa.png

Greetings fellow Alchemists,

thank you all for the feedback regarding our game! Based on your suggestions and information, we made some fixes/improvements, which are live... now ːsteamhappyː:


 crashing the game (XBox controller issue)
 additional information about putting back knife after sharpening
 add arrows in the Graph of Aspects
 appropriate counting down days left while making a quest
 disappearing/falling into the floor
 graphics improvements in Credits

notes.title: New trailer and official release date!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35238896/411de70c56e2dbb58aed131edba47711873cd249.png

ːsteamhappyː It’s here! A new gameplay trailer for Alchemist Simulator and the official release date! Are you ready for some magic? We’re starting brewing potions on 23rd October! How many recipes will you discover? Awake your childhood dreams. Become an alchemist. Create your own legend!

We will have some more videos to show you before release so stay tuned. And now let the new trailer speak for itself. ːsteammockingː
